description: This file defines the ConfigEntry class hierarchy and related utilities for managing Spark configuration entries, including handling defaults, optional values, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: ConfigEntry
classes.description: Abstract class representing a configuration entry with metadata and methods for reading and default handling.

classes.name: ConfigEntryWithDefault
classes.description: Implementation of ConfigEntry with a fixed default value.

classes.name: ConfigEntryWithDefaultFunction
classes.description: Implementation of ConfigEntry with a default value provided by a function.

classes.name: ConfigEntryWithDefaultString
classes.description: Implementation of ConfigEntry with a default value specified as a string.

classes.name: OptionalConfigEntry
classes.description: ConfigEntry that may or may not have a value (optional).

classes.name: FallbackConfigEntry
classes.description: ConfigEntry that falls back to another ConfigEntry if not set.

methods.name: defaultValueString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the default value.

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads the configuration value from a ConfigReader, applying defaults if necessary.

methods.name: registerEntry
methods.description: Registers a ConfigEntry in the global known configs map.

methods.name: findEntry
methods.description: Finds a registered ConfigEntry by key.
